page.overview:
Who is Johnny Joestar?

Obtain the Saint's Corpse to be able to walk again|birthplace=|married=Married (Part 8)|ja_romaji=Jonyi Jōsutā|imgtabs= Part 7 =

A former prodigy turned , Johnny joins the Steel Ball Run race to uncover the secret behind Gyro Zeppeli's Steel Balls as they're the only thing capable of restoring his legs.

Over the course of the race, Johnny becomes a Spin User as well as a Stand User when he acquires Tusk.

Johnny is a young man of below-average height and slim to medium build. He has light eyes, and light, shoulder-length hair curling upwards at its ends.
